title: Torah Literary Units Dataset
description: The 86 literary units of the Torah as identified by the Woven Torah hypothesis, each a two-dimensional composition of rows and columns. The dataset carries no scriptural text: every cell is given as a verse range, so the woven reading can be reconstructed from any translation. Served at https://chaver.com/torah-weave/data/torah-units.json under CC BY 4.0.

license.description: CC BY 4.0. Attribution to Moshe Kline (chaver.com) is required.

citation.description: The preferred citation for the dataset.

methodology.description: Page setting out the method by which the units were identified.

total_cells.description: Cells across all units, counting each cell once.

total_cells_with_subdivisions.description: Cells across all units, counting subdivided cells by their parts.

books.description: How the 86 units are distributed across the five books, and the range of serial numbers each book covers.

serial_range.description: First and last serial_number belonging to this book.

format_key.description: How to read the format field. Reproduced from the dataset itself.

type_key.description: How to read the type field. Reproduced from the dataset itself.

serial_number.description: The unit's position in the Torah as a whole, from Creation at 1 to the close of Deuteronomy at 86.

unit_number.description: The unit's position within its own book.

verses.description: The unit's full extent including the book name, e.g. 'Genesis 1:1-2:3'.

verse_range.description: The same extent without the book name, e.g. '1:1-2:3'.

format.description: The unit's shape. Either 'NxM' for a regular unit of N rows by M columns, or a string of digits for an irregular unit, each digit giving the number of columns in that row. See format_key.

irregular.description: True when the rows do not all carry the same number of columns, in which case format is a digit string.

unique.description: True when the unit is not grouped in a triadic pattern with other units.

cells.description: Number of cells in the unit, counting each cell once.

cell_count_with_subdivisions.description: Published per-unit count relating to subdivided cells. Note that this figure is not consistently derivable from cells_detail across the dataset; to count a unit's cells, read cells_detail directly.

type.description: Structural role, present only on units that carry one. See type_key.

cells_detail.description: The heart of the dataset: every cell label mapped to the verses it contains. A label is a row number followed by a column letter — 1A, 1B, 2A — with a further lowercase letter for a subdivision within a cell, as in 2Aa. Ranges are written 'chapter:verse' or 'chapter:verse-chapter:verse', and are relative to the unit's own book.
